title: Enroll existing accounts with a password
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Prove the legacy key once and set a password on the same account. Retire old credentials according to the recorded cutover policy.

**Verify** · Enroll both roles from a copied store. Wrong key and interrupted retry preserve valid data. Show IDs, files and distinct settings before and after.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-055, WI-056, WI-058

**Queue** · Follows WI-059 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
